title: SEBI Measures Curtail Retail Equity F&O Net Losses to ₹91,685 Crore in FY26
summary: SEBI F&O rationalisation measures reduced aggregate retail equity derivative losses from ₹1,11,788 crore to ₹91,685 crore in FY26.

blocks.content: SEBI F&O rationalisation measures reduced aggregate retail equity derivative losses from ₹1,11,788 crore to ₹91,685 crore in FY26.

items: **Loss Reduction:** Net retail losses in equity derivatives curtailed from **₹1,11,788 crore to ₹91,685 crore** in FY26.
**Unique Individual Traders:** Unique retail traders declined to **78.60 lakh**.
**Key Reform Measures:** Weekly index derivative rationalisation, higher contract sizes, upfront option premium, removal of expiry day calendar spreads.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: F&O Reforms: Introduced under SEBI Master Circular on Equity Derivatives.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Loss Figures:** Total retail F&O net loss stood at ₹91,685 crore in FY26.
